name: Artemis Campaign (ADD Baseline)
description: Reference Artemis campaign following the program of record in NASA's Moon-to-Mars Architecture Definition Document, with propellant aggregation for a Starship-class HLS. Values are notional or published (see artemis/artemis_add_campaign.py and artemis/validation.py).

nodes.name: NRHO
nodes.description: Near Rectilinear Halo Orbit (approximated as Earth-Moon L2)

nodes.name: LSP-2
nodes.description: Lunar South Pole (Shackleton rim, within walk-back distance)

edges.name: KSC-LEO (SLS Block 1B)
edges.description: SLS Block 1B Earth ascent (the exploration upper stage completes the ascent; equivalent delta-v calibrated to the published Block 1B crew capability)

edges.name: LLO-NRHO
edges.description: Transfer to near rectilinear halo orbit

edges.name: KSC-LEO (Super Heavy)
edges.description: Launch of a Starship-class ship (dry mass, residual propellant, and payload) to LEO

edges.name: LEO-KSC (Ship Return)
edges.description: Entry and landing of a Starship-class ship for reuse

edges.name: KSC-NRHO (Falcon Heavy + SEP)
edges.description: Commercial launch and solar electric propulsion transfer of Gateway elements to NRHO

edges.name: KSC-NRHO (Falcon Heavy, Logistics)
edges.description: Commercial launch and low-energy transfer of logistics to NRHO (NASA NRHO white paper, 2023: ~115 m/s, 120 days for cargo)

edges.name: KSC-LSP (Cargo Lander)
edges.description: Commercial delivery of surface cargo to the south pole
